name: wp-first-touch-guard-counts-click-ids
description: [MERGE-LEVEL][PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] hasFirstTouch() counts ft_<clickid> keys, so a stored payload holding ONLY ft_gclid blocks any new first touch. Engine's ftEmpty check looks only at source/medium/campaign/referrer/landingPage and would overwrite ft with the new touch.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #17): first-touch emptiness guard counts ft_<clickid> keys -- a bare-gclid landing IS a first touch. Original note: plugin preserves original ft; engine previously overwrote ft fields with the newer UTM touch. Fixture harness supports top-level 'stored'.
